question: The former Spanish footballer, Antonio Lopez Habas, was the coach at the Hero ISL 2020-21 of which of the following football teams?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ATK Mohun Bagan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The former Spanish footballer, Antonio Lopez Habas,** was the coach at the** Hero ISL 2020-21 of ATK Mohun Bagan.**
 
• He is a former defender and manager in **the Spanish professional football league.**
 
• On March 15, 2020, he signed with the newly created ATK Mohun Bagan.
 
• His team finished level with Mumbai City in the first stage of his debut season, but was pushed down to second place on head-to-head points and lost the final 2–1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **ATK Mohun Bagan FC** is a West Bengal-based Indian professional football team.
 
• The club competes in the Indian Super League, one of the country's premier football leagues.
 
• ATK Mohun Bagan FC was founded as a result of a merger between the football section of multi-sport club Mohun Bagan AC and the ATK FC in the 2020–21 season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football Club Goa **is an Indian professional football club based in Goa, that competes in the Indian Super League, the top flight of Indian football. The club was established on 26 August 2014. 
 
• **Kerala Blasters Football Team**, also known as The Blasters, is an Indian professional football club headquartered in Kochi, Kerala, that competes in the Indian Super League, the country's highest level of football. 
 
• **The East Bengal Club** is a professional football club situated in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The club was founded in 1920 and competes in the Indian Super Competition, India's top flight, as well as the Calcutta Premier Division A, Asia's oldest football league.
